title: Brain Trace Event
description: One JSONL line written by the brain's capture hooks. Phase A of the Datadog-inspired observability ports (Port 1 — Agent Trace). Three event classes are captured: skill_fire, agent_activate, phase_boundary. Strict additionalProperties to catch typos; schema evolution happens via v1 → v2 (new $id path).

schemaVersion.description: Frozen at write-time so a future schema can identify record vintage.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision, e.g. 2026-05-18T21:42:13.501Z.

event.description: Event class. Determines which optional fields are meaningful.

name.description: For skill_fire: skill slug (e.g. 'querymaster'). For agent_activate: agent slug. For phase_boundary: one of the 4D phases.

task_id.description: Stable id grouping all events of a single user task. For human-driven turns: sha1 of first user message. For autonomous turns (loop, cron, session_start with no prompt): ad-hoc UUID v4. Always a string; never null.

arm.description: Arm slug if the event was triggered inside an arm working dir; null for brain-internal events. Arm isolation rule still applies: this is a counter signal only, the arm's own data is never written into the brain trace.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration in milliseconds. Populated on agent_activate completion and on phase_boundary close events; null for fire-and-forget events.

tokens.description: Token usage observed during the event, when available. null when unknown (e.g. local hooks with no LLM call).

status.description: Outcome class. ok = clean completion. error = failed and an `error` string is required. partial = completed with degraded result (e.g. retry succeeded after transient failure).

error.description: Brief error message when status=error; null otherwise. Keep <500 chars; full stack traces belong in arm logs, not the brain trace.

allOf.description: When status=error, the error field must be a non-empty string.
phase_boundary.name is restricted to the 4D phase vocabulary.
